note: Both sets contain the same 12 claims in substance: the second-order response, ωφn and ζφ formulas, the negative damping from the generator-torque controller, the negative ∂P/∂θ in Region 3, the PI gain expressions, and the design targets ωφn = 0.6 rad/s and ζφ = 0.6 to 0.7. The only difference is wording of the blade-pitch sensitivity claim (Set A gives 'aerodynamic property' as the value with the dependencies as conditions; Set B folds the dependencies into the value), and both are faithful to the page. Both sets also repeat the 0.6 rad/s and 0.6–0.7 targets under two entity names each, so both carry the same duplication issue.
remarks: Both sets state the design targets twice (once as 'blade-pitch controller' and once as 'rotor-speed error response' targets) — the same fact under two names. Neither set captures the roles of the derivative/proportional/integral terms (effective inertia, damping, restoring) or the requirement that the proportional term compensate the generator-torque negative damping, which are notable facts on the page.
